Are refunds and changes handled by the same team?
No, they are seperate queues. Changes are done on the call; refunds are queued to ticketing and settle to the original form of payment in 7-14 days. Source: CRM-FAQ-EN-001.

Helios Air cancelled my flight. Do I pay to move to another flight?

No. On an airline-caused cancellation a CLASSIC passenger pays no change penalty and is moved free of charge to the next Helios service the same day. Penalties apply only to a voluntary cancellation or change. Source: CRM-FAQ-EN-001.

I did not show up for my flight. Can I still use the ticket?
A no-show forfeits the change waiver and doubles the cancellation penalty stated in the fare rule. Remaining coupons are suspended until the amount is collected. Source: CRM-FAQ-EN-001.

Duty of care depends on how long you wait for the next service. Meal vouchers and hotel accommodation are governed by SOP-MISCONNECT. Use the current revision — older revisions remain in the archive and carry different figures.

My bag did not arrive. What happens now?

A PIR (Property Irregularity Report) is raised and the passenger is given a tracking number. The bag is traced on that number. If it is not found within 21 days it is declared lost and the compensation file is opened. Never raise a second PIR for the same bag; use the existing number. Source: CRM-FAQ-EN-001.

Which fare families does Helios Air sell?

LITE, CLASSIC and FLEX, on two route bands: SHORT-HAUL (Europe) and LONG-HAUL. LITE is the most restricted: cancellation is not permitted. Penalty amounts sit in the fare rule documents, per booking class and per direction. Agents read the amount from the rule, not from this FAQ. Source: CRM-FAQ-EN-001.
